title: Page 9
content_zh:
他虚弱的扬了下嘴角，他至少护大了闺女的骨血，他可以下去见她了。

他喃喃低语，“代马依北风，我想回去……你姥姥等我很久了。”

周屹天心痛如绞的怒吼，“别胡说！他们要杀的是我，该死的也是我。你跟我回京，我把他们都杀了，我把他们都杀了！”

顾乔成只觉胸口一阵灼热的疼，“你啊，该懂事了。”

就算知道全天下只有一人想取周屹天性命，但无凭无据，若真冲动杀人，到时也得赔上自己。

周屹天的心针扎似的痛着，止不住眼中向外涌出的眼泪。

顾乔成心头泛软，对他一叹，“勿骄，勿躁，勿狂，勿惧。”像是用尽最后一丝力气，他气若游丝的交代，“至尊者至刚，忍……我还盼着你……名扬天下。”

周屹天绝望的看着顾乔成闭上了眼，咽下最后一口气，嘶喊了一声，“姥爷！”

赵小丫泪水爬满双颊，心的一角在这个夜晚碎了，纵使恢复，她仍知道伤痕永远都在。

【本段不纯洁的描写已删减，万分抱歉】

竹屋的混乱和血腥已被清理，看来一如往常，但是众人心知肚明，全都已不同。

顾良追击杀了余孽，捉了两个活口，如今就吊在竹楼廊道上的横梁。

周屹天让手下清理了竹屋内外的黑衣人，将尸首丢进山谷里喂野兽，让他们纵使死后也别妄想得全尸。

赵小丫愣愣看着一脸严肃的周屹天，脑子浮现的是上一世不苟言笑，战场上冷酷狠绝的。

莫名的，她害怕初识时嘴巴毒辣，偶尔吊儿郎当的他消失……她双眸低垂，蒙上一层说不清道不明的伤痛。

两个活口的嘴很硬，坚决不透露丝毫讯息，还妄想要谈条件。

周屹天听到后站起身走了过去，周岳见了立刻退让到一旁。

被捉的活口满是血丝的眼睛看向周屹天。

若说昨夜周屹天勇猛地以一敌多令人胆颤心寒，如今他冰冷的眼眸更令人寒毛直竖,并不是他们忠心，而是清楚若是全盘托出，就只有死路一条，死咬不说兴许能有一线生机。

周屹天面无表情的看着两人，眼神未动分毫，没等他们出声说一句话，已经抽出周岳的剑直接削了一人的脑袋。

另一人见同伴身首分离，惊恐万分的看着周屹天。

周屹天没给他说话的机会，用同样的手法让他一剑毙命，血溅到身上和脸上，他眼也不眨。

一旁的周岳浑身震了震，脑子混沌的接过周屹天递过来的剑，剑峰上的血迹滴落在地。

“清理干净。”周屹天的声音没有半点温度，人命消逝在他眼中已无法激起波澜。

“爷，你失血过多。”顾良神情倒是平静，走到了周屹天的身旁，对一旁的血腥视而不见，“还是歇息几日再赶路不迟。”

周屹天冷冷看向顾良，转身进屋，毫无温度的丢下一句，“把这里烧了，即刻回京。”

在角落的赵小丫闻言猛然回过神，抬头看向周屹天，纵使看不清低垂着头的他此刻的眼神，但她能感受他身上散发阴沉的气息。

周岳心中担忧，只能将求助的目光投向赵小丫。

赵小丫对上他的视线，最后选择沉默。

周屹天一心要将顾乔成尽快带回京安葬，任何人周岳无奈，只能让人收拾。

赵小丫缓缓的走向周屹天，顾良防备的看了她一眼，但最后不知想到了什么，默默的退到了门边。

赵小丫低垂眼眸，注意到他的手中把玩着一对狼牙，她曾在上辈子看过他挂在颈上，从未取下，想来讽刺，如今才知来处。

她伸出手想碰他的脸，但他却是一侧，闪过了她的手。

她的手僵在半空中，如今的他连她都接近不了。

她收回手，敛下眼眸退到了一旁，静静的看着他，心酸的明白，有些事冥冥之中自有定数，纵使她重生一世也改变不了旁人的命中注定。

坐在马车上，赵小丫忍不住掀起马车的车帘，远远可见竹林方向火光闪动。

种种回忆闪过脑海，最终只剩细不可察的一叹。

她的目光落在一身月白色长袍，玄色大氅，身姿挺拔地骑在马上的周屹天，由始至终他都未曾回头。

她眷恋不舍的松开手，收回看他的视线。

头轻靠在车壁，她无声的落泪，莫名的，她知道他在躲自己，他不想她接近。

无求便无痛，难道最终的结局便是如此？

有些悲伤无人能懂，只能靠自己痊癒。

周屹天若执意不让她靠近，她也无能为力。

今年的雪下得早，越靠近京城越冷，寒风卷着大雪铺天而来，不过一夜，天地已是一片苍白。

赵小丫知道自己病了，喉咙如火烧，身子发烫，但是依然强打起精神没让人发现，不想影响一行人赶路。

周屹天未曾坐上马车，也没想着要歇息，一路急赶回京。

赵小丫只能把对他的担忧压在心里，她无力的靠在车壁，轻咳几声，人昏沉了起来。

她原以为自己不同了，结局也会不同，如今才知她以为变了，却什么都没改变……

迷迷糊糊之中，她彷佛回到上辈子，恭敬的低头站在周屹天面前，看他手中拿着她借给他过目的兽牙手串，他颈上的狼牙坠链在她低垂的眼前一晃而过，她妄想伸手碰触，却只捉了个空。

转眼画面来到冰消雪化的京城——明日他将成亲，夜色之中，站在景福桥上都能看到远处侯府张灯结彩。

她捧着侯府特意交代她亲自送去的药膳步上桥，鬼使神差的停下脚步，望着远处侯府的热闹出神。

她听不见，不知身后有人靠近，当她察觉不对，转头只来得及看到推向她的一双手，右手腕内侧有一块赤红胎记。

流动的水中还有融雪时的冰碴子，她冻得无力挣扎，挣扎不开骇人的窒息感。

画面转到烧掉竹林的大火，一把火彷佛烧了一切，但却什么也没烧毁，因为痕迹可以抹去，伤痕却刻在心里。

或许用尽一切力气，她终究逃不开命中注定。

她痛苦难受，如同胸中有火在烧，猛然睁开眼，对上的是周屹天近在咫尺的目光。

她有一瞬间的迷茫，想要开口却惊觉自己失了声音，浑身使不上力。

“姑娘受了风寒，醒来喝上几帖药，再休养些时日便无碍。”大夫恭敬的在一旁说道。

周岳道了谢，将大夫请出去。

大夫写好药单，迫不及待的收拾东西。

两天前，周岳上门，原以为就是个再寻常不过的出诊，谁知道他被带到城郊的小庄子里，直到现在才能归家。

坐在床边的周屹天一身煞气太重，目光始终停留在那个昏迷不醒的姑娘身上，他一点都不怀疑，这个姑娘若有个万一，自己别想完好的走出庄子。

如今真是千恩万谢，这个姑娘终于醒来，自己留着小命可以离开。

赵小丫浑身无力，只能转动眼珠子看着四周。

周屹天没说话，只是把她扶起，让她靠着自己，拿了杯温水让她就着他的手喝。

喝够了，她无力的轻摇了下头。

周屹天将杯子放下。

靠着他的身子，赵小丫看着四周，房间摆设典雅，一道木座画屏隔开内外间，隐约可见外间领着大夫离去的周岳。

“这是顾家老宅。”周屹天看出她的疑惑，沉声开口。

这代表他们到了，她虚弱的挤出一抹笑，用尽力气，出口的声音却细不可闻。

他仔细一听才听到她说“爷爷”，回答道：“后日入土。”
content_en:
He raised the corner of his mouth weakly. At least he had protected his daughter's flesh and blood, and he could go down to see her.

He murmured, "I want to go back on behalf of Ma Yibeifeng... Your grandma has been waiting for me for a long time."

Zhou Yitian roared with heartache, "Don't talk nonsense! It's me they want to kill, and I deserve to die. Come back to Beijing with me, and I'll kill them all, I'll kill them all!"

Gu Qiaocheng felt a burning pain in his chest, "It's time for you to be sensible."

Even if you know that there is only one person in the world who wants to take Zhou Yitian's life, but there is no evidence, if you really kill someone impulsively, you will have to pay for it when the time comes.

Zhou Yitian's heart hurt like a needle, and he couldn't stop the tears pouring from his eyes.

Gu Qiaocheng's heart softened and he sighed to him, "Don't be arrogant, don't be impetuous, don't be crazy, don't be afraid." As if he had exhausted his last bit of strength, he said angrily, "The Supreme One is the most strong, patient... I still hope that you... become famous all over the world."

Zhou Yitian watched in despair as Gu Qiaocheng closed his eyes, took his last breath, and shouted, "Grandpa!"

Tears filled Zhao Xiaoya's cheeks, and a corner of her heart was broken this night. Even if she recovered, she still knew that the scars would always be there.

[The impure description in this paragraph has been deleted, I am extremely sorry]

The chaos and bloodshed in the bamboo house had been cleaned up, and it seemed like it was the same as before, but everyone knew that everything was different.

Gu Liang chased and killed the remnants and captured two alive, who are now hanging from the beams in the corridor of the bamboo building.

Zhou Yitian asked his men to clean up the men in black inside and outside the bamboo house, and threw the corpses into the valley to feed the wild animals, telling them not to get rid of the corpses even after they died.

Zhao Xiaoya stared blankly at Zhou Yitian, who had a serious face. What came to his mind was the unsmiling and ruthless nature of his previous life on the battlefield.

Inexplicably, she was afraid that he would have a vicious mouth when they first met, and he would occasionally disappear carelessly... Her eyes were lowered, covered with a layer of inexplicable pain.

The two living mouths were very tough, determined not to reveal any information, and even tried to negotiate terms.

After Zhou Yitian heard this, he stood up and walked over. When Zhou Yue saw him, he immediately stepped aside.

The captured man looked at Zhou Yitian with bloodshot eyes.

If Zhou Yitian's bravery last night against many enemies was frightening and chilling, now his cold eyes are even more chilling. It's not because they are loyal, but because they know that if they tell everything, there will be only death. If they keep silent, there may be a glimmer of hope.

Zhou Yitian looked at the two of them expressionlessly, without moving his eyes. Before they could say a word, he had already drawn Zhou Yue's sword and cut off one of them's head.

The other man saw his companion's body and head separated and looked at Zhou Yitian in horror.

Zhou Yitian didn't give him a chance to speak, and used the same technique to kill him with one sword. Blood splattered on his body and face, but he didn't blink.

Zhou Yue on the side was shaken all over, and he took the sword handed over by Zhou Yitian with a confused mind. The blood on the sword peak dripped to the ground.

"Clean it up." Zhou Yitian's voice had no warmth at all, and the disappearance of human life could no longer stir up waves in his eyes.

"Master, you lost too much blood." Gu Liang looked calm and walked to Zhou Yitian's side, turning a blind eye to the blood beside him. "It's not too late to rest for a few days before rushing on."

Zhou Yitian looked at Gu Liang coldly, turned around and entered the room, saying without any warmth, "Burn this place down and return to Beijing immediately."

Zhao Xiaoya, who was in the corner, suddenly came back to her senses when she heard this and looked up at Zhou Yitian. Even though she couldn't see clearly the look in his eyes with his head lowered, she could feel the gloomy aura emanating from him.

Zhou Yue was worried and could only turn to Zhao Xiaoya for help.

Zhao Xiaoya met his gaze and finally chose to remain silent.

Zhou Yitian wanted to bring Gu Qiaocheng back to Beijing for burial as soon as possible. Zhou Yue had no choice but to have others take care of him.

Zhao Xiaoya slowly walked toward Zhou Yitian. Gu Liang glanced at her defensively, but in the end he thought of something and silently retreated to the door.

Zhao Xiaoya lowered her eyes and noticed that he was playing with a pair of wolf fangs in his hand. She had seen him hanging them around his neck in a previous life and had never taken them off. She wanted to be sarcastic, but now she knew where they came from.

She reached out to touch his face, but he turned aside and dodged her hand.

Her hand was frozen in mid-air, and now he couldn't even get close to her.

She retracted her hand, lowered her eyes and stepped aside, looking at him quietly, understanding sadly that some things had their own destiny, and even if she was reborn, she could not change the fate of others.

Sitting on the carriage, Zhao Xiaoya couldn't help but lift the curtain of the carriage, and she could see the flames flashing in the direction of the bamboo forest in the distance.

All kinds of memories flashed through my mind, and in the end, only an imperceptible sigh remained.

Her eyes fell on Zhou Yitian, who was wearing a moon-white robe and a black cloak, riding a horse upright. From the beginning to the end, he never looked back.

She reluctantly let go of her hand and looked back at him.

Leaning her head lightly against the car wall, she cried silently. Inexplicably, she knew that he was hiding from her and he didn't want her to get close.

If there is no need, there will be no pain. Is this the final outcome?

There are some sorrows that no one can understand and you can only heal on your own.

If Zhou Yitian insists on not letting her get close, there is nothing she can do.

The snow fell early this year, and the closer we got to the capital, the colder it became. The cold wind blew heavy snow across the sky, and in just one night, the sky and the earth turned pale.

Zhao Xiaoya knew that she was sick, her throat was burning, and her body was hot, but she still managed to keep herself up without anyone noticing, as she did not want to affect the group's journey.

Zhou Yitian didn't even get on the carriage, nor did he want to rest. He hurried all the way back to Beijing.

Zhao Xiaoya could only suppress her worries about him in her heart. She leaned against the car wall weakly, coughed a few times, and became drowsy.

She originally thought that if she was different, her ending would be different, but now she realizes that she thought she had changed, but nothing has changed...

In her daze, she seemed to be back in her previous life, standing in front of Zhou Yitian with her head bowed respectfully, looking at the animal tooth bracelet in his hand that she lent him to see. The wolf tooth pendant around his neck flashed past her lowered eyes. She tried to reach out to touch it, but she only missed it.

In the blink of an eye, the scene came to the capital city where the ice and snow had melted - he would get married tomorrow. In the night, standing on the Jingfu Bridge, one could see the lanterns and decorations of the Marquis Mansion in the distance.

She walked up the bridge holding the medicated meal that the Hou Mansion specially asked her to send in person. She stopped unexpectedly and looked at the bustle of the Hou Mansion in the distance.

She couldn't hear and didn't know someone was approaching behind her. When she realized something was wrong, she turned around and saw a pair of hands pushing towards her. There was a red birthmark on the inside of her right wrist.

There were still ice fragments from the melting snow in the flowing water. She was too frozen to struggle, and she couldn't struggle away from the terrible suffocation feeling.

The scene switches to a fire that burned down the bamboo forest. The fire seemed to have burned everything, but nothing was burned, because the traces can be erased, but the scars are engraved in the heart.

Perhaps despite all her efforts, she could not escape her destiny.

She was in pain, as if there was a fire burning in her chest. She suddenly opened her eyes and met Zhou Yitian's gaze, which was very close at hand.

She was confused for a moment. She wanted to speak but was surprised to find that she had lost her voice and couldn't use her strength.

"The girl has caught a cold. When she wakes up, drink some medicine and rest for a while, she will be fine." The doctor said respectfully.

Zhou Yue thanked him and invited the doctor out.

The doctor wrote down the medicine order and couldn't wait to pack his things.

Two days ago, Zhou Yue came to visit. He thought it was an ordinary medical visit. Who knew that he was taken to a small village on the outskirts of the city and could not return home until now.

Zhou Yitian, who was sitting by the bed, was filled with evil spirits, and his eyes were always fixed on the unconscious girl. He had no doubt at all that if something happened to this girl, he would not be able to walk out of Zhuangzi intact.

Now I am so grateful that this girl finally wakes up and can leave with her own life.

Zhao Xiaoya was so weak that she could only turn her eyes and look around.

Zhou Yitian didn't say anything, he just lifted her up and let her lean against him, and got a glass of warm water for her to drink from his hand.

After drinking enough, she shook her head weakly.

Zhou Yitian put down the cup.

Leaning against his body, Zhao Xiaoya looked around. The room was elegantly furnished. A wooden screen separated the inside and outside. Zhou Yue, who was leading the doctor away, could be vaguely seen outside.

"This is the Gu family's old residence." Zhou Yitian noticed her confusion and spoke in a deep voice.

This meant that they had arrived. She weakly forced out a smile and tried her best, but the sound was inaudible.

He listened carefully and heard her say "Grandpa" and replied: "He will be buried the day after tomorrow."
